items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I would go into town, go to my Aunt Jenny’s, and get something to eat.

ctx.x: Did you have any ideas about what you thought your future was going to be at that point?

The voice was there and I knew – because if I’d have done four years of college, I would have been a teacher, and I couldn’t see that. I didn’t think that that was going to work for me. And, as I said, the work was there. As a freshman, you’re not supposed to go off campus. I went home every week. Because, first of all, the cafeteria. You see my size. I’ve always been tiny. I would have to go home and get a decent meal. I had relatives who lived near the campus. So if I got – I could not bear cafeteria food. So I…
